exposure: prenatal screening for hepatitis B serological markers
hepatitis B vaccine administration (0, 1, 6 month schedule)
oral antivirals (28-32 weeks gestation until delivery)
outcome: hepatitis B serological markers in infants
cohort: These guidelines are for healthcare providers managing pregnant women with positive HBsAg and their newborn infants.
finding: The guidelines provide recommendations for prenatal screening, infant immunoprophylaxis (HBIG + vaccine), and maternal antiviral therapy (for high HBV DNA levels) to prevent mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus.
mod_finding: Cesarean section is not recommended to reduce MTCT of HBV.
gest_age: N/A (Antivirals for mothers start at 28-32 weeks gestation, but no specific gest_age range for infants is defined for outcomes beyond general mention of 'preterm neonates')
